title: 壁付け屋外監視カメラ
description: 壁付け金具、角度調整ヒンジ、奥まったレンズ、日除けフードと背面ケーブル付きの静的カメラ模型。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A static exterior camera prop with wall mounting plate, tilt hinge, recessed optical lens, weather hood and rear cable. No recording or surveillance functionality. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
